map.单机 GPS 的 UERE 通常 1~5m（取决于星历、电离层、接收机），默认取: The UERE of a standalone GPS is typically 1-5 m (depending on ephemeris, ionosphere and receiver); 3 m is taken by default for estimation. With SBAS or RTK the UERE can fall to sub-metre or even centimetre level, shrinking the corresponding error by an order of magnitude.
map.定位质量：由 PDOP/HDOP/VDOP 与可见卫星数评估实时定位可信度: Positioning quality: assess the reliability of real-time positioning from PDOP/HDOP/VDOP and the number of visible satellites
map.是，PDOP 反映卫星几何分布（越小越分散、越利于定位）；PDOP>10 几何条: Yes, PDOP reflects the geometric distribution of satellites (the smaller it is the better dispersed the satellites and the better the positioning). With PDOP > 10 the geometry is poor and the positioning error grows markedly, so wait for a better satellite distribution or use RTK or differential augmentation.
map.算法：校验 PDOP≈√(HDOP²+VDOP²)；三维误差≈PDOP×UERE: Algorithm: check PDOP ~= sqrt(HDOP^2 + VDOP^2); 3D error ~= PDOP x UERE, horizontal error ~= HDOP x UERE, vertical error ~= VDOP x UERE (UERE is the equivalent range error of a single receiver, 3 m by default...
map.误差预算：用 UERE（等效测距误差）估算水平/垂直/三维误差: Error budget: use UERE (equivalent range error) to estimate horizontal, vertical and 3D error
